title: Agent Team Designer
subtitle: Takes a project's goal and its source material, explores that material through the search tools, proposes a roster of specialist agents, and writes their skill guides and agent definitions.
lede: Takes a project's goal and its source material, explores that material through the search tools, proposes a roster of specialist agents, and writes their skill guides and agent definitions. A person reviews them first; they are then deployed, archived and restored on request, and the team can be stood up with those members.
who: A founder or team lead who wants a set of specialist assistants built around their own material
author: Corey James
